horoscope: There is a continued focus on relationships and companionship today, dear Aries, and feeling supported or reminiscing about a past relationship in a happy way can be in focus. Someone special or having company helps you get in better touch with your feelings and affections. Others can be helpful. The Moon continues to highlight your need for others today, and later today, it heads into your solar eighth house, stirring your need to observe and reflect. Processing your feelings and recent events seems important now. This can be a time for seeing a new layer of a situation, perhaps even remembering a past matter differently, and it's revealing.

While you're more inclined to focus on your daily affairs much of today, dear Taurus, it's also a fine time for harmonizing and cooperating with others, particularly those you deal with as you pursue your daily routines. Mixing work with pleasure is not always successful, but today it may very well be. This can also be a time for showing you care about someone through help and support. A past project or pursuit can look more attractive right now. The urge to be around people or to soak up ideas and inspiration from others is strong as the day advances.

You're likely to enjoy a spirit of cooperation early today, dear Gemini, and social pleasures are in special focus. Today's transits may bring gentle attraction so that you may find people and things coming to you rather than having to pursue them. The Moon continues its transit of your creative sector today, but then moves into your work and health sector, and you'll find that taking care of business satisfies you most later today. This is a time for organizing your life in small but essential ways, with a focus on the details, and it's a time when you thoroughly enjoy piecing things together.

In the first part of the day, family matters, domestic issues, or your personal life are in stronger focus, dear Cancer. Creating more harmony and balance in your personal life will feel most rewarding, and you might revisit past projects that look appealing again. You might seek refuge from demanding situations or quiet time. The morning is good for building emotional strength and self-esteem, and for relationships with close loved ones and family. As the day advances, you're ready to share yourself with others, interact, and express yourself.

You're inclined to dabble rather than specialize today with the Moon in your third house for part of the day, dear Leo, and with Venus there, too, you're likely to enjoy it thoroughly! This can be considered a useful interlude in the lunar cycle. Even mindless chatting can serve a purpose now, whether it merely relaxes you, giving you a break from heavy thinking, or ultimately leads to bigger and better things. Turning your attention to old projects or interests or returning to recent conversations can be useful now. The day begins in a pleasantly busy way, and as it progresses, you seem to need more comfort, familiarity, and quiet.

You're inclined to go about your business rather quietly today, dear Virgo. The power of the present and living in the moment is evident right now. It's a potentially beautiful day for enjoying creature comforts or practical and sensual, earthy activities. You're less concerned about your independence than your sense of security today. You can have both, of course, but today, you'd do well to build on what you have and slow down so that you can figure out your next step. Aim to be centered and receptive. The day is likely to get busier as it progresses, and possibly a little less satisfying if you're not adjusting to the quicker pace.

Enjoy the pleasant vibes of the Moon coming together with Venus, both in your sign, dear Libra. Favorable energy is with you for self-expression, friendship, and a positive self-image. Working towards the goal of increased happiness and health are in strong focus. You're not necessarily more emotional than usual, but you're certainly more in touch with what you're feeling. Conversations with friends or ideas shared with a team or group can be supportive and notable now. People want to cooperate with you. As the day advances, you're more inclined to want to make or build something substantial. The Moon moves into your resources sector, and you crave more stability and predictability to center and ground yourself.

You're coming to the end of a lunar cycle and need some time to recoup your energies, dear Scorpio. The general mood inspires attention to your inner world. You're seeking a healthy escape from the usual fare, and emotional refreshment is easier to find than usual. The Moon and Venus align in your privacy sector, encouraging you to follow your intuition. Activities that honor your need to reconnect with your inner spirit are particularly timely now. While connections are expected to be pleasant today, you may be content to merely muse about your relationships or enjoy a sense of contentment with others from afar. The Moon enters your sign later today, stirring a strong need to feel connected and acknowledged. Until then, take the time to rest, reflect, and meditate if you can.

With the Moon and Venus aligning in your social sector early today, dear Sagittarius, you may get a nice boost from sharing ideas with others or supporting a friend. More than usual, you're seeking satisfaction and comfort from your social life. You might discover or rediscover interesting goals, skills, and ideas as you network, and perhaps some information that happily fills in a few blanks or rewrites a situation in a pleasant way. Later today, the Moon heads into your privacy sector, and you'll do well to pause your busy schedule and enjoy a temporary, pleasant lack of ambition!

This can be an excellent time to enjoy the rewards of recent accomplishments, dear Capricorn, and to consider new goals. There can be particular joy in what you're doing or in your responsibilities today. You're bringing something unique and special to the table, and you might be thinking a lot about past projects and pursuits and reassessing their merits. As the day advances, you crave more recreation. You might feel more comfortable stepping back from the action or intense situations, but you're in real need of intellectual companionship or stimulation, making light conversation an ideal choice now.

You crave a real sense that you're growing, learning, or improving today, dear Aquarius. Rallying up others' cooperation is relatively easy today, and connections made now can help you broaden your horizons. It might thoroughly make sense to take a break from excessive thinking, organizing, analyzing, and managing. Grab opportunities to lighten up and release stress. Later today, taking care of business, taking the lead, and performing at your best become more appealing as the Moon heads to the top of your solar chart. You may not have things handed to you at this time, but it can be quite satisfying to put in the effort.

The Moon continues its transit of your intimacy sector, cozying up to Venus there, dear Pisces, and enhancing your sense of peace and comfort with your feelings. Your private life gets a nice, gentle boost. You are quite sensitive to the people and happenings around you, but in a mindful, confident way. You can gain valuable insight into your work and health matters. As the day progresses, you're interested in getting out and about or participating more actively. The Moon heads into your spirit sector, and you're looking ahead.
